chapters.title: Meet Captain Chloroplast
chapters.narrativeHook: Welcome to Tree City! Deep inside every leaf, our tiny superhero Captain Chloroplast catches glowing solar beams while bouncing off vibrant green light!
chapters.visualAnimationCue: 3D Pixar-style camera zoom from a giant leafy canopy down into a bustling microscopic city cell. A heroic green character with solar-panel armor catches yellow light beams while green sparkles reflect away.
chapters.interactiveElement: Tap the solar rays to help Captain Chloroplast absorb light!

chapters.title: The Water-Splitting Zap
chapters.narrativeHook: To harness this solar energy, our hero leaps onto the thylakoid disc solar pads and zaps water molecules to unleash raw power!
chapters.visualAnimationCue: Inside a glowing thylakoid disc, Captain Chloroplast uses solar energy rays to split a floating H2O water bubble. Sparking H+ ions charge up while oxygen gas floats upward like friendly bubbles.
chapters.interactiveElement: Swipe to split incoming water bubbles into hydrogen and oxygen!

chapters.title: Supercharging the Batteries
chapters.narrativeHook: All that solar energy charges up our leaf city's high-energy battery crew: ATP and NADPH!
chapters.visualAnimationCue: Electric sparks flow from the thylakoid into adorable battery-shaped characters labeled ATP and NADPH. They glow bright blue and yellow with enthusiastic grins as they power up.
chapters.interactiveElement: Drag solar sparks into ATP and NADPH to charge them!

chapters.title: The Calvin Sugar Factory
chapters.narrativeHook: Over in the fluid stroma plaza, the Calvin Cycle wheel turns! Carbon dioxide rushes in, battery power activates, and sweet glucose sugar is forged!
chapters.visualAnimationCue: A futuristic spinning clockwork wheel in the fluid stroma captures floating CO2 molecules. The supercharged ATP and NADPH batteries plug in, pressing out glowing golden glucose sugar bricks.
chapters.interactiveElement: Spin the Calvin Cycle gear to assemble glucose sugar!

chapters.title: Powering the World
chapters.narrativeHook: Glucose fuels the giant metropolis tree, while fresh oxygen keeps all life breathing. Photosynthesis powers our whole planet!
chapters.visualAnimationCue: Camera zooms out rapidly from the microscopic chloroplast through the leaf, revealing a grand 3D tree shining in sunlight, releasing oxygen bubbles that support animated animals below.
chapters.interactiveElement: Pinch out to reveal the full thriving ecosystem!
